Name: True Rune - Powerful Dialogue Patcher
Author: Riou0903
Description:
[size=5][b]True Rune: Dialogue Director[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Conditional. Rotating. Stateful. Dialogue Rules Engine.[/i][/size]

[size=4][b]The pitch[/b][/size]

Drop [b]one JSON file per NPC[/b] and take total control of what they say. Rules react to mail flags, hearts, season, day of week, festivals, where an NPC is standing, even which [color=#9ACD32]$q[/color] question the player picked an hour ago — and a line can talk [i]back[/i]: ask a branching question, hand over a gift, set a flag. The engine re-resolves on [i]every[/i] interaction — no day-rollover wait, no save-and-reload.

[size=4][b]In-game settings (GMCM)[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46638/46638-1779633776-825218506.png[/img]
[i]Every setting is toggleable in-game without editing config.json.[/i]

[size=4][b]Works Alongside Content Patcher Mods [/b][/size]

True Rune: Dialogue Director is an [b]additional[/b] engine. Your existing Content Patcher dialogue mods should still keep working — you do [b]not[/b] need to migrate anything. See the "Works alongside Content Patcher" section below for a worked test.

[size=4][b]What TRD adds beyond Content Patcher's EditData Dialogue/<NPC>[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Live evaluation.[/b] Set a flag → next click, the new line fires.[/*]
[*][b]Priority + rotation built in.[/b] Tie three greetings at the same priority and they shuffle + cycle automatically.[/*]
[*][b]max_uses quota.[/b] "Show this once per save" is one integer field — persisted to the save file for you.[/*]
[*][b]Cross-NPC heart gates.[/b] Haley's line can react to Emily's friendship. CP cannot.[/*]
[*][b]Answer-history gates.[/b] Follow-up lines that only fire if the player picked branch A earlier.[/*]
[*][b]Festival dialogue.[/b] Opt-in festival lines — egg hunt banter, a Flower Dance partner line, a Winter Star toast — without clobbering the scripted ceremony. CP can't replace the festival free-roam chit-chat the way TRD can.[/*]
[*][b]Interactive questions, gifts & side effects.[/b] Author a branching [color=#9ACD32]$q[/color] question, hand the player an item, set a flag, or add money — all from plain JSON keys ([color=#9ACD32]question[/color], [color=#9ACD32]gift[/color], [color=#9ACD32]set_flags[/color], [color=#9ACD32]actions[/color]) that compile to the exact Stardew tokens for you.[/*]
[*][b]Where-are-they gates.[/b] Fire a line because an NPC is standing at the Beach right now — or because their schedule already took them there earlier today.[/*]
[*][b]Authors-friendly JSON.[/b] Field names describe what they do. No tokens, no When clauses, no patch directives.[/*]
[*][b]AI-friendly.[/b] The full authoring guide ships inside the zip — paste it into Claude/ChatGPT with your synopsis and you get working JSON back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Concrete comparison — same three lines in CP vs. TRD[/b][/size]

Take these three Haley rainy-day lines from a real Content Patcher mod (Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion):

[code]
"CFE_Haley_rainy_1": "I spent all morning doing my hair... now the rain could mess it up.$s#$e#*sigh* ... Life is hard sometimes."
"CFE_Haley_rainy_2": "Yikes. No offense, but you are soaked."
"CFE_Haley_rainy_3": "*sigh* To think... there are people on sunny beaches in other parts of the world right now.$s"[/code]
…wired up in [color=#9ACD32]content.json[/color] with:

[code]
{
  "LogName": "CFE_Haley_Include",
  "Action": "Include",
  "FromFile": "Data/NPCs/Haley.json",
  "When": {
    "Query: '{{CFE_Haley}}' = 'true' OR ('{{CFE_Haley}}' = 'random' AND '{{Random: true, false}}' = 'true')": true
  }
}[/code]
[b]What's hard to tell from this:[/b]
[list]
[*]Which of the three lines will the player actually see today? (The randomness lives in a [color=#9ACD32]{{Random}}[/color] token elsewhere — you have to trace tokens to know.)[/*]
[*]Can a single line be limited to "show at most once per save"? (Not natively — you'd need a custom save-data token or another mod.)[/*]
[*]Can line #2 be gated on "only if it's actually raining AND it's Tuesday AND the player has 4+ hearts"? (Possible, but you stack more [color=#9ACD32]When[/color] clauses and tokens.)[/*]
[*]Can the three lines [i]rotate[/i] (each fires once before any repeats), instead of pure random with possible repeats? (Not without external bookkeeping.)[/*]
[/list]
[b]The same three lines as a TRD pack:[/b]

[code]
{
  "npc": "Haley",
  "replacements": {
    "rainy": [
      {
        "id": "haley_rainy_hair",
        "priority": 10,
        "min_heart": 2,
        "weather": "rain",
        "text": "I spent all morning doing my hair... now the rain could mess it up.$s#$e#*sigh* ... Life is hard sometimes."
      },
      {
        "id": "haley_rainy_soaked",
        "priority": 10,
        "weather": "rain",
        "max_uses": 3,
        "text": "Yikes. No offense, but you are soaked."
      },
      {
        "id": "haley_rainy_beaches",
        "priority": 10,
        "weather": "rain",
        "date": { "days_of_week": ["tuesday"] },
        "text": "*sigh* To think... there are people on sunny beaches in other parts of the world right now.$s"
      }
    ]
  }
}[/code]
[b]What you get from that without writing any extra logic:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Every condition lives on the line it gates.[/b] No cross-file token chasing — you read one rule and you know exactly when it fires.[/*]
[*][b]Rotation is automatic.[/b] All three are at priority 10, so they enter a rotation pool: shuffled once, then cycled — no immediate repeats.[/*]
[*][b]Per-line usage caps.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]max_uses: 3[/color] on the "soaked" line means it fires at most 3 times across the entire save, then permanently bows out. Persisted to the save file for you.[/*]
[*][b]Mix gates freely.[/b] Heart minimums, weather, day-of-week, mail flags, and cross-NPC heart conditions all stack on the same rule with plain field names.[/*]
[*][b]Conversation-window throttle.[/b] By default each NPC shows at most 3 TRD lines per in-game time window before falling back to vanilla — configurable via [color=#9ACD32]MaxLinesPerConversationWindow[/color] in config.json, and individual rules can opt out with [color=#9ACD32]force_show[/color].[/*]
[/list]
This is the headline win: [b]you can read a single rule and immediately know what it does[/b], and the engine handles rotation + quota bookkeeping for you.

[size=4][b]Works alongside Content Patcher mods[/b][/size]

If TRD finds a matching rule for the current context, that line wins. If [i]nothing[/i] in TRD matches, the game falls back to whatever Content Patcher (or vanilla Stardew) would have shown. You can keep all your existing CP dialogue mods installed — TRD just layers on top.

[b]Worked test — Rainy Tuesday, talking to Haley[/b]

Setup:
[list]
[*][b]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/b] (a Content Patcher mod) installed, which adds three possible rainy-day lines:[/*]
[/list][code]
"CFE_Haley_rainy_1": "I spent all morning doing my hair... now the rain could mess it up.$s#$e#*sigh* ... Life is hard sometimes."
"CFE_Haley_rainy_2": "Yikes. No offense, but you are soaked."
"CFE_Haley_rainy_3": "*sigh* To think... there are people on sunny beaches in other parts of the world right now.$s"[/code]
[list]
[*]A TRD content pack with one rule:[/*]
[/list][code]
{
  "npc": "Haley",
  "title": "Worked example covering every Dialogue Director feature.",
  "replacements": {
    "_smoke_test": [
      {
        "id": "smoke_test_always_on",
        "priority": 1,
        "max_uses": 1,
        "text": "$h[Sample Pack] Hello @! If you see this line, True Rune: Dialogue Director is working."
      }
    ]
  }
}[/code]
[b]Result 1 — TRD rule matches, TRD wins:[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46638/46638-1779714344-297084548.png[/img]
[i]"[Sample Pack] Hello @!..." — TRD found a matching rule, so it overrides both CP and vanilla.[/i]

[b]Result 2 — TRD has no match (max_uses exhausted), falls back to Content Patcher:[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46638/46638-1779714349-49917736.png[/img]
[i]With max_uses already spent, TRD has nothing eligible — so the CFE Content Patcher line shows instead.[/i]

[b]Result 3 — Neither TRD nor any CP mod matches, falls back to vanilla Stardew dialogue:[/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46638/46638-1779714344-1974450651.png[/img]
[i]Final fallback: the original game line, untouched.[/i]

[b]TL;DR[/b] — if a TRD rule matches, it plays. Otherwise the game proceeds exactly as it would without TRD installed, including any Content Patcher edits.

[b]One caveat — you cannot mix TRD and CP rules inside a single content pack folder.[/b] A SMAPI manifest can only declare one [color=#9ACD32]ContentPackFor[/color] target. Content Patcher packs need:

[code]
"ContentPackFor": { "UniqueID": "Pathoschild.ContentPatcher" }[/code]
…and TRD packs need:

[code]
"ContentPackFor": { "UniqueID": "Riou.TrueRune.Dialogue", "MinimumVersion": "1.0.0" }[/code]
If you want to ship both, just ship two folders side-by-side in the same zip — players drop both into [color=#9ACD32]Mods/[/color] and they coexist normally.

[size=4][b]Festival dialogue — without breaking the festival[/b][/size]

Festivals are where most dialogue mods give up. Stardew routes festival talk through a different code path, so a normal edit never even fires. TRD hooks that path too — but carefully:

[list]
[*][b]Opt-in per rule.[/b] A rule only speaks at festivals if you mark it [color=#9ACD32]"festivals": true[/color] (any festival) or list specific [color=#9ACD32]"festival_ids": ["spring24"][/color]. Your everyday lines never bleed into festival day, and your festival lines never leak onto a normal day.[/*]
[*][b]The ceremony stays sacred.[/b] Only the walk-around social period is touched. The dance, the soup-tasting, the egg hunt countdown — left exactly as the game intended.[/*]
[*][b]Questions still work.[/b] The Flower Dance "…ask me to be your partner?" prompt — and any festival [color=#9ACD32]$q[/color] question — always shows through unchanged, so the player can still answer it. TRD replaces the chit-chat around it, never the question itself.[/*]
[*][b]A line for the moment you're chosen.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]is_dance_partner: true[/color] fires only after the player picks this NPC as their Flower Dance partner — so you can write a special "you and me, center of the floor" reply that the generic festival line never sees.[/*]
[*][b]One global switch.[/b] [color=#9ACD32]EnableDuringFestivals[/color] (GMCM, default on) turns all of it off in one click.[/*]
[/list]
[code]
{
  "id": "haley_flowerdance_partner",
  "festival_ids": ["spring24"],
  "is_dance_partner": true,
  "priority": 10,
  "text": "$l You and me, center of the dance floor. Don't step on my toes, @!"
}[/code]
Supported festival ids: [color=#9ACD32]spring13[/color] (Egg), [color=#9ACD32]spring24[/color] (Flower Dance), [color=#9ACD32]summer11[/color] (Luau), [color=#9ACD32]summer28[/color] (Moonlight Jellies), [color=#9ACD32]fall16[/color] (Fair), [color=#9ACD32]fall27[/color] (Spirit's Eve), [color=#9ACD32]winter8[/color] (Ice), [color=#9ACD32]winter25[/color] (Winter Star).

[size=4][b]Interactive questions, gifts & side effects[/b][/size]

A line doesn't have to be just a line. TRD lets a rule [i]do[/i] things — ask the player a branching question, hand them an item, set a story flag, drop some gold — all from readable JSON keys that compile down to the exact Stardew tokens for you. No hand-writing dense [color=#9ACD32]$q[/color]/[color=#9ACD32]$r[/color]/[color=#9ACD32]$action[/color] strings.

[code]
{
  "id": "haley_beach_invite",
  "priority": 80,
  "force_show": true,
  "text": "...Okay. Random question, don't make it weird.$7",
  "question": {
    "prompt": "Free spring afternoon -- the beach, or stuck inside?",
    "answers": [
      { "id": "98010", "text": "The beach, with you.",  "friendship": 20,  "reply": "...Good answer.$l" },
      { "id": "98011", "text": "Inside, catching up.",   "friendship": -10, "reply": "...Hopeless.$u", "reask": true }
    ]
  },
  "gift": "392",
  "set_flags": ["MyMod_asked_to_beach"],
  "actions": ["AddMoney 500"]
}[/code]
[list]
[*][b]question[/b] — a full branching prompt with per-answer friendship changes and inline replies. The engine derives the [color=#9ACD32]$q[/color] id list, fills the replies, and auto-suppresses re-asking for you. Mark a "decline" answer [color=#9ACD32]"reask": true[/color] to keep nudging.[/*]
[*][b]gift[/b] — give an item when the line ends. Bare id → an object; a qualified id like [color=#9ACD32](BC)13[/color] passes through.[/*]
[*][b]set_flags[/b] — set mail flags so later rules (yours or another pack's) light up immediately.[/*]
[*][b]actions[/b] — the escape hatch for everything else: [color=#9ACD32]AddMoney[/color], [color=#9ACD32]AddQuest[/color], [color=#9ACD32]AddSpecialOrder[/color], [color=#9ACD32]AddConversationTopic[/color], and more.[/*]
[/list]
Answer a question on Monday, and a follow-up rule gated on [color=#9ACD32]answered_question_ids[/color] can react to that choice days later. That's stateful, branching conversation — in JSON a non-programmer can read.

[size=4][b]Quick start for authors[/b][/size]

Your content pack is just a folder with a manifest and a [color=#9ACD32]TrueRune/dialogue/[/color] subfolder:

[code]
MyDialoguePack/
├── manifest.json   (ContentPackFor: "Riou.TrueRune.Dialogue")
└── TrueRune/
    └── dialogue/
        └── Haley.json[/code]
The [color=#9ACD32]TrueRune/[/color] umbrella keeps every True Rune Toolkit subsystem under one folder. If your pack also ships [color=#9ACD32]TrueRune/events/[/color], the Events framework picks those up via cross-discovery — you only declare [color=#9ACD32]ContentPackFor[/color] once.

A minimum-viable [color=#9ACD32]Haley.json[/color]:

[code]
{
  "npc": "Haley",
  "replacements": [
    {
      "id": "spring_morning",
      "priority": 5,
      "min_heart": 4,
      "date": { "seasons": ["spring"] },
      "text": "$h Spring mornings are the best, @!"
    }
  ]
}[/code]
Drop into [color=#9ACD32]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color] → launch → talk to Haley. That's the whole loop.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46638/46638-1779633771-280146334.png[/img]
[i]Your line in-game, gated on heart level and season — no further setup.[/i]

[size=4][b]Schema reference[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#9ACD32]id[/color] — Identifier for logging, rotation, and max_uses tracking[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]priority[/color] — Higher wins. Ties go into rotation.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]text[/color] — The dialogue, with portrait codes ([color=#9ACD32]$h $u $l $7 $12[/color]…)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]question[/color] — Branching [color=#9ACD32]$q/$r[/color] prompt with per-answer friendship + inline replies[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]gift[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]set_flags[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]actions[/color] — Give items, set flags, or run [color=#9ACD32]$action[/color] side effects when the line ends[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]required_AND_flags[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]required_OR_flags[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]forbidden_flags[/color] — Gate by player mail flags[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]answered_question_ids[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]forbidden_question_ids[/color] — Gate by past [color=#9ACD32]$q/$r[/color] choices[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]min_heart[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]max_heart[/color] — Heart level with this NPC[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]npc_heart_conditions[/color] — Heart level with OTHER NPCs[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]npc_current_location_conditions[/color] — An NPC is standing at a location right now[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]npc_current_schedule_conditions[/color] — An NPC's schedule took them to a location today (optional time window)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]date[/color] — Season + day-of-week + day + year window[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]gender[/color] — Restrict a line to the player's gender ([color=#9ACD32]male[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]female[/color]). Omit for no constraint.[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]festivals[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]festival_ids[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]is_dance_partner[/color] — Opt a rule into festivals (any, or specific ones) and the Flower Dance partner moment[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]max_uses[/color] — Hard cap on lifetime plays (save-persistent)[/*]
[*][color=#9ACD32]force_show[/color] — Bypass the per-NPC conversation window limit[/*]
[/list]
A complete worked example covering every feature ships in [color=#9ACD32]samples/Sample-EmilyDialoguePack/[/color] in the repo. Full schema docs live in [color=#9ACD32]docs/DIALOGUE_AUTHORING.md[/color] inside the zip.

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0+[/url][/*]
[*][i]Recommended:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for the in-game settings page[/*]
[*]Drop the unzipped folder into [color=#9ACD32]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/color][/*]
[*]Install any content pack that requires this framework[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Console commands (prefix rune_dlg_)[/b][/size]

· [color=#9ACD32]rune_dlg_reload[/color]
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_dlg_list [NPC][/color]
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_dlg_try <NPC>[/color]
· [color=#9ACD32]rune_dlg_clearusage[/color]
· Flag / answer gating: use vanilla [color=#9ACD32]debug seenMail[/color] / [color=#9ACD32]debug question[/color]

Type [color=#9ACD32]help rune_dlg_<name>[/color] in the SMAPI console for usage.

[size=4][b]C# API[/b][/size]

[code]
var api = Helper.ModRegistry.GetApi<IDialogueDirectorApi>("Riou.TrueRune.Dialogue");
api.RegisterRules("Haley", myRules, ownerUniqueId: ModManifest.UniqueID);[/code]
